spring.name: Spring
spring.arrival: Spring has come. The soil is soft and ready for seeds.

summer.name: Summer
summer.arrival: Summer is here. Crops grow fast, but fields dry quickly.

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.arrival: Autumn colours the valley. Bring in the harvest before winter.

winter.name: Winter
winter.arrival: Winter settles in. Fields rest until spring — the stores will feed everyone.
